# Spectrum packs

Two-ended prompts for the **Spectrum** game: the psychic sees a hidden point on the
line between `Left` and `Right` and gives a clue; everyone else guesses where it lands.

These pairs are original, common-language antonyms and scales written for this project
— free to edit, extend, or replace. Drop a `.txt` file here (or in your user packs
dir) using the same grammar as the other games:

```
Pack: My Pack Name
Left: Cold
Right: Hot
---
Left: Cheap
Right: Expensive
```

The spectrum-guessing genre was popularised by the board game *Wavelength* (CMYK) and a
web version by [Ben Chen](https://github.com/heybenchen/wavelength) (MIT); this game is
inspired by that genre but ships its own content and uses the name **Spectrum**.
